description: tiktok: Get Song Details. GET /v1/tiktok/song. Get details for a TikTok sound or song. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

clipId.description: TikTok sound clip ID (clipId), not songId: the trailing number in a /music/ URL. The /music/ URL itself is accepted too.
